description: Cross-language vectors for runhmd.receipt/1, written by receipts-worker/scripts/gen-vectors.py from bin/lib/runhmd_receipt.py. See that script's docstring for how the two suites replay them.

receipts.name: denied-canonical-lf
receipts.note: a DENIED receipt exactly as `hmd attack --receipt` writes it

receipts.name: no-trailing-lf
receipts.note: the canonical form without the final LF is also a valid file

receipts.name: proven-with-gate
receipts.note: a PROVEN receipt with a falsified passing gate

receipts.name: unicode-titles
receipts.note: quotes, backslash, markup, accents, an astral character, U+2028 and a control character

receipts.name: title-200-astral
receipts.note: 200 code points that are 400 UTF-16 units: valid, length is counted in code points

receipts.name: integral-numbers
receipts.note: cost 3 and duration 134 are written without a fraction

receipts.name: leap-day-2000
receipts.note: 29 February in a century leap year

receipts.name: duplicate-member
receipts.note: verdict repeated with the same value (a parser keeps the last)

receipts.name: count-at-2-pow-53
receipts.note: an attack count Python and JavaScript would both misread

receipts.name: signature-noncanonical-base64
receipts.note: same 64 bytes, last base64 character spelled with non-zero padding bits

receipts.name: stranger-signer
receipts.note: validly signed by a signer that is not trusted

receipts.name: forged-signer-id
receipts.note: names the trusted signer's id but is signed by another

receipts.name: extra-member
receipts.note: a signed receipt with an extra member (minimal_input)

receipts.name: proven-with-unfalsified-gate
receipts.note: PROVEN over a gate that passes but was never falsified

receipts.name: february-30
receipts.note: created_at on a day that does not exist

receipts.name: id-with-slash
receipts.note: an id that is not a safe token

receipts.name: byte-order-mark
receipts.note: a UTF-8 BOM before a valid file

receipts.name: invalid-utf8
receipts.note: a byte that is not UTF-8 inside a string

receipts.name: over-size
receipts.note: a valid file padded with spaces past the size limit
